name: Sauce Labs
description_en:
Sauce Labs provides hosted browser and mobile-device testing alongside a broader quality platform now presented as AURA. Public plans distinguish manual live testing, automated virtual devices and automated real devices. Framework support and enterprise AI features should be evaluated under the selected product rather than inferred from a platform headline.

This profile follows a Selenium test’s remote session, regional endpoint, private-network route and assertion reporting. It separates unlimited minutes from purchased concurrency and a finished session from a meaningful test result. No account, access key, browser, device, tunnel, test or paid resource was operated.
description_zh:
Sauce Labs 提供托管浏览器及移动设备测试，并以 AURA 介绍更广泛质量平台。公开方案区分人工实时测试、自动虚拟设备及自动真实设备；框架支持和企业 AI 应按所选产品评估，不能由平台标题推定。

本文沿 Selenium 测试评估远端会话、区域端点、私有网络路径及断言上报，区分无限分钟与购买并发，以及会话完成与有意义测试结果。本次未操作账户、访问密钥、浏览器、设备、隧道、测试或付费资源。

Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Select the test cloud before assuming device coverage
sections.title_zh: 先选测试云再判断设备覆盖
sections.en: Live Testing is described as manual testing, while Virtual Device Cloud and Real Device Cloud have different automation/device scopes. The pricing page limits the named AI authoring and insights agents to enterprise offerings. Choose the actual browser/device target and entitlement, then verify its availability. A broad AURA promise is not evidence that the entry plan includes every AI capability or physical device configuration.
sections.zh: Live Testing 描述为人工测试，Virtual Device Cloud 与 Real Device Cloud 的自动化／设备范围不同。价格页将所列 AI 编写及洞察 Agent 限于企业方案。需先选实际浏览器／设备及权益并核可用性，不能将 AURA 总体承诺当作入门层包含全部 AI 或物理设备配置的证明。

sections.title_en: A remote session needs options and a lifecycle
sections.title_zh: 远端会话需要选项及生命周期
sections.en: The Selenium guide selects a regional Remote WebDriver endpoint and browser options, then locates elements, acts and asserts. It recommends environment variables for account credentials. End the driver session with quit so results and artifacts can finish processing. A visible browser is only the execution environment; the test still needs a deliberate assertion and cleanup. No sample or displayed credential placeholder was executed.
sections.zh: Selenium 指南先选区域 Remote WebDriver 端点及浏览器选项，再定位、操作及断言；建议账户凭据用环境变量。结束时需 quit 以完成结果／产物处理。可见浏览器只是执行环境，测试仍需明确断言及清理。本次未执行示例或凭据占位符。

sections.title_en: Region choice affects both execution and artifacts
sections.title_zh: 区域选择同时影响执行及产物
sections.en: The data-center guide says the chosen region determines test execution and related artifact storage. Trial/self-service customers choose at signup; enterprise access follows the contract. It lists US West, US East, EU Central and Asia South, but excludes Virtual Device Testing from US East and Asia South. Confirm the required combination and all relevant endpoints before assuming a regional endpoint supports the same workload as another.
sections.zh: 数据中心指南称所选区域决定测试执行及相关产物存储。试用／自助客户注册时选择，企业访问按合同。其列出美国西部、美国东部、欧洲中部及南亚，但美国东部和南亚不支持 Virtual Device Testing。应核所需组合及相关端点，不能假定各区域支持同一负载。

sections.title_en: A private target requires a configured route
sections.title_zh: 私有目标需要已配置路由
sections.en: Sauce Connect 5 runs a client in the operator’s environment to connect private or local applications to Sauce infrastructure. The guide describes encrypted HTTP/2 tunnels and optional routing/proxy features, plus metrics for monitoring tunnel health. Starting a session does not prove the target’s DNS, proxy and access configuration work. Test a controlled endpoint and distinguish tunnel failures from application assertions; no network policy or server exposure was changed.
sections.zh: Sauce Connect 5 在运维环境运行客户端，将私有或本地应用连接至 Sauce 设施。指南介绍加密 HTTP/2 隧道、可选路由／代理及隧道监控指标。创建会话不证明目标 DNS、代理及访问配置正确。应测试受控端点，区分隧道失败和应用断言，本次未改网络策略或开放服务器。

sections.title_en: The runner must report its assertion outcome
sections.title_zh: 运行器必须上报断言结果
sections.en: Sauce’s Selenium guide explicitly says the service does not know what the client code asserts and relies on the test to send that information. Report the framework’s actual outcome before ending the session, including failure paths. Inspect assertion evidence rather than treating a completed job or video as an automatic pass. The documented reporting mechanism was read, not integrated or tested.
sections.zh: Sauce Selenium 指南明确说明服务不知道客户端代码断言内容，依赖测试发送结果。因此结束会话前需上报框架真实结果，包括失败路径。应检查断言证据，不能把完成的任务或视频当作自动通过。本次仅读取上报机制，未集成或测试。

sections.title_en: Result visibility depends on organization settings
sections.title_zh: 结果可见范围受组织设置影响
sections.en: The results guide separates Live and Automated views and Virtual versus Real devices. Live owner filters can show organization-wide owners only when the corresponding visibility setting is enabled; otherwise they are team-scoped. Use the correct view and preserve the build/environment context for diagnosis. Screenshots, logs or recordings may contain application data, so confirm sharing and retention in the actual account rather than assuming test isolation also defines artifact access.
sections.zh: 结果指南分 Live／Automated 视图及虚拟／真实设备。Live 所有者筛选仅在相应可见设置启用时显示全组织，否则限团队。排障需选正确视图并保留构建／环境上下文。截图、日志或录制可能含应用数据，应在实际账户核共享／保留，不能假定测试隔离也规定产物访问。

sections.title_en: Unlimited minutes do not mean unlimited parallel sessions
sections.title_zh: 无限分钟不代表无限并行会话
sections.en: For the displayed one-parallel selection, Live is $39/month billed annually or $49 monthly; Virtual is $149/$199 and Real Device is $199/$249 respectively. Unlimited-minute claims sit alongside selected concurrency, and virtual/real plans list five hundred monthly visual snapshots. Select the actual parallel count and workload before estimating total cost. Currency, tax, enterprise features and purchased-capacity behavior were not checked at checkout.
sections.zh: 显示的一并发选择下，Live 年付月均 $39 或月付 $49；Virtual 分别 $149／$199，Real Device 为 $199／$249。无限分钟与所选并发并存，虚拟／真实方案另列每月五百视觉快照。估算总价前需选实际并发和负载；本次未在结账核币种、税、企业功能及已购容量行为。
